title: が (subject)
meaning: Marks the grammatical subject; identifies "which one"; used with question words, existence, likes/abilities, and descriptions.
simpleExplanation: が marks the subject: the thing that exists, does something or has a quality. The simplest rule for a beginner: が points out WHICH thing. So it goes after question words (誰が "who"), in answers to those questions (田中さんが "Tanaka did"), when saying something exists (猫がいます "there is a cat") and before feeling and ability words (寿司が好きです "I like sushi").
whenUsed: Question words (誰・何・どれ・どこ), existence (あります・います), likes and skills (好き・嫌い・上手・下手), understanding and ability (分かる・できる), wanting (ほしい), and describing something noticed for the first time (雨が降っています).
formation: Noun + が + あります／います
Noun + が + 好き／嫌い／上手／下手／分かる／できる／ほしい

rows.label: Existence
cells: 猫はいます (as for the cat, it's here)
猫がいます (there is a cat)

examples.reading: だれが きましたか。
examples.note: A question word is always followed by が.
Existence: "a cat exists". The thing that exists takes が.

examples.reading: わたしは すしが すきです。
examples.note: The object of 好き takes が, not を.

examples.ja: A：誰が来ましたか。　B：田中さんが来ました。
examples.reading: だれが きましたか。　たなかさんが きました。
examples.note: The answer to a が question also uses が.

examples.ja: すみません、時間がありません。
examples.reading: すみません、じかんが ありません。
examples.note: "There is no time": the thing that (doesn't) exist takes が.

similarGrammar.difference: は marks what you are talking about (old information); が marks the subject and new information.
を marks what an action is done to (パンを食べる). 好き, 分かる and ほしい are not actions, so they take が.
A different が: after a clause it means "but".

commonMistakes.wrong: 私は日本語を分かります。
commonMistakes.right: 私は日本語が分かります。
commonMistakes.why: 分かる, できる, 好き and ほしい take が, not を.

commonMistakes.right: 何を食べますか。／ 何が好きですか。
commonMistakes.why: A question word never takes は.

commonMistakes.wrong: 机の上に本はあります。(as first mention)
commonMistakes.right: 机の上に本があります。
commonMistakes.why: When you point out that something exists (new information), use が.

usageNotes: Question words (誰・何・どれ) are always followed by が, never は. The object of 好き・嫌い・上手・下手・わかる・できる・ほしい takes が.
jlptTips: Check the word after the blank. If it is あります・います・好き・上手・分かります・できます・ほしい, the answer is が.
Check the word before the blank. If it is 誰・何・どれ・どこ・いつ, the answer is が (never は).
